verdict.rationale: Abacum documents group-based role assignment for managing user permissions across the workspace, which covers the scoped-access part of the story. It also documents investor-reporting outputs where the board deck and narrative build from live actuals. However, no evidence shows dashboards or reports being shared directly with board members or teammates under per-report or per-dashboard scoped access. Missing for 10: documented dashboard/report sharing flow, board/viewer-level or external-guest access, per-report permission scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.
